offer: Cancel auto insurance policy on 2021 Honda Accord. Vehicle has been sold. No longer require coverage. Also: completing private-party sale of the Accord for $18,800 — title transferred, proceeds deposited to savings.
why_they_accept: Priya cannot refuse a cancellation — James owns no vehicle and has no legal obligation to carry auto insurance. She loses a $127/month premium. This is a standard policy termination, not a negotiation. Her only mitigation is to offer James a renters or umbrella policy to offset the lost premium, but that is her move to make, not his.
